head_neck: the head and neck, including the face, hair, beard and anything worn on the head
torso_pelvis: the chest, abdomen and pelvis, including the waistband area and clothing covering them, but never sleeves or anything covering the arms
near_upper_arm: the near upper arm from its shoulder to its elbow, including any sleeve covering it
near_forearm_hand: the near forearm and hand, from the elbow to the fingertips, including sleeves, cuffs and gloves
far_upper_arm: the far upper arm from its shoulder to its elbow, including any sleeve covering it
far_forearm_hand: the far forearm and hand, from the elbow to the fingertips, including sleeves, cuffs and gloves
near_thigh: the near thigh from the hip to the knee, including the clothing covering it
near_shin: the near shin from the knee to the ankle, including the clothing covering it
near_foot: the whole near foot below the ankle: skin, toes and heel together with any footwear, whether shoes, boots, sandals or socks
far_thigh: the far thigh from the hip to the knee, including the clothing covering it
far_shin: the far shin from the knee to the ankle, including the clothing covering it
far_foot: the whole far foot below the ankle: skin, toes and heel together with any footwear, whether shoes, boots, sandals or socks
back_accessory: anything attached to the back that sits behind the torso and the far arm, such as wings, a cape or a backpack; unused when the character has nothing like that
held_item: a weapon, staff, tool or prop held in a hand, but not the hand itself; unused when the character holds nothing
